title: Couple Getaway to Japan | Journey to the Land of the Rising Sun
highlights: Enjoy a captivating journey through Japan, where timeless temples, modern marvels, thrilling theme parks, and rich cultural encounters create an unforgettable experience.
Step into the spiritual heart of Tokyo at Sensoji Temple, where incense-scented air, ancient architecture, and bustling Nakamise Street bring centuries-old traditions to life.
Step back into Japan’s feudal era at Osaka Castle, a historic icon surrounded by moats and cherry trees, reflecting the might of the legendary samurai Toyotomi Hideyoshi.
Unleash your inner movie buff at Universal Studios Japan, where action-packed rides, cinematic worlds, and character meet-and-greets promise a full day of fun.
Dive into the vibrant energy of Akihabara Electric Town, Tokyo’s mecca for anime, manga, and gaming culture, where neon-lit streets brim with themed cafés and otaku treasures.
overview:
About the tour:
Embark on an unforgettable journey through Japan, blending tradition, culture, and modern thrills. Begin in Tokyo, where after arrival and a leisurely start, you’ll dive into the city's highlights—from the sacred Meiji Shrine to the panoramic Tokyo Skytree—with a city tour. Next, get a chance to relive childhood with a day at Tokyo Disneyland, offering an amazing glimpse into the world of Disney. Then ascend to Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station and cruise Lake Ashi, with stunning views of the surroundings. Also, get a chance to shop at Gotemba Outlets, where top international and Japanese brands offer great deals against the scenic backdrop of Mt. Fuji. As you arrive in Osaka, enjoy a lively sumo show with chanko nabe. Later, explore the historic Osaka Castle, and spend a thrilling day at Universal Studios Japan. End with a cultural day trip to Kyoto & Nara, visiting majestic temples and friendly deer before bidding farewell to this beautiful country.

know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each guest at the time of booking and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, a traditional house, or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Japan! Upon landing at Narita International Airport, get driven to the hotel. After checking in, spend the day at leisure, where you can head out and indulge in luxury shopping at Ginza, Tokyo’s stylish retail hub, or immerse yourself in culture with a live performance at the Samurai Theater. Also, you can take a relaxing walk through the lush Yoyogi Park or witness the vibrant energy of Shibuya Crossing, one of the world’s most famous intersections.

items.title: Check-in at Shinjuku Washington Hotel Annex

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, head to Shinjuku Love Statue & board th bus for the Tokyo City tour. Pass by iconic sights like Godzilla Head in Kabukicho & historic National Diet Building. Glide past tech-central Akihabara, bustling Ameyoko Market & Kappabashi Dougu Street, known for kitchenware. Also, make a stop at the ancient Meiji Jingu Shrine & timeless Sensoji Temple with its grand Kaminarimon Gate & bustling Nakamise-dori. Later, get driven to Shinjuku St. West Exit. From there, head to the hotel on your own.

items.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Shinjuku LOVE Statue (With Lunch)

days.title: Day Trip to Disneyland
days.desc: In the morning, set off for a magical day trip at Tokyo Disneyland, one of Asia’s most iconic theme parks, known for its immersive lands and world-class entertainment. Once there, step into World Bazaar, styled like an early 20th-century American town, or explore themed zones like Adventureland, Tomorrowland, and Fantasyland, home to classics like It’s a Small World and Peter Pan’s Flight. Get a chance to indulge in thrilling rides, live parades, character meet-and-greets, and themed dining.

days.title: Trip to Mt. Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets
days.desc: Today, head to the Shinjuku Center Building meeting point and board your transfer and visit Mt. Fuji’s 5th Station, offering stunning views. Next, indulge in shopping top brands at Gotemba Premium Outlets, set against a backdrop of Mt. Fuji, before getting driven to Hakone for the Hakone Ropeway over the dramatic Ōwakudani Volcanic Valley, famed for its steaming vents and black eggs. Later, enjoy a pirate ship cruise on Lake Ashi before getting driven to JR Shinjuku Station's West Exit.

items.title: Trip to Mt Fuji 5th Station, Hakone & Gotemba Outlets

days.title: Transfer to Osaka | Osaka Sumo Show Experience
days.desc: Post check-out, head to Tokyo Station and board your train to Osaka. Upon arrival, head to your hotel on your own and check in. Later, get driven to Sumo Restaurant for a one-of-a-kind cultural evening with the Osaka Sumo Show. Once there, get a chance to savor chanko nabe, the traditional stew of sumo wrestlers, while watching a live sumo performance. Also, you can step into the sumo ring yourself & explore exhibits featuring the attire of sumo legend Konishiki, the first foreign-born Ozeki.

items.title: Transfer in Bullet Train (Shinkansen)
items.desc: 1 X Bullet Train (Shinkansen) will be Provided

items.title: Check-in at APA Hotel Shin Osaka Ekimae

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour
days.desc: Begin by gathering at the meeting point of your tour- Exit 2 of Tanimachi 4-Chome St. Start by exploring Osaka Castle, famed for its architecture. Next, wander through Koreatown & marvel at its vibrant street culture. Don't miss Tennoji Ward, famed for Harukas, Japan’s tallest non-tower building, offering views of Kobe. Also, enjoy the vibe of Shinsekai, known for its colorful neon signs & lanterns. Do visit Dotonbori, where you can try delicious street food, particularly takoyaki & kushikatsu.

days.title: Day Trip to Universal Studios
days.desc: Today, get driven to dive into a world of movie magic with a full-day adventure at Universal Studios Japan in Osaka—one of Asia’s top entertainment destinations. Once there, explore attractions inspired by global blockbusters like Harry Potter, Jurassic Park, Minions, and Spider-Man. Also, stroll through the Wizarding World of Harry Potter or take a ride on the Flying Dinosaur. Don't miss witnessing magical parades or live shows & also savor delicious meals at various themed restaurants inside.

days.title: Visit to Kyoto,  Nara & Arashiyama | Arashiyama Sagano train Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven Nipponbashi & board the bus for a scenic adventure. Start with Nara Park, where friendly deer roam freely, & explore Fushimi Inari Taisha, known for its striking path of thousands of red torii gates. Next, get driven to Kyoto St. to board the connecting train to Torokko Saga Station & from there enjoy Sagano Scenic Train Ride offering views of the Hozugawa River & forested hills. Later, disembark at Arashiyama station to stroll through the peaceful Bamboo Grove & Kimono Forest.

items.title: Kyoto & Nara Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka
Arashiyama Sightseeing Tour - Departure from Osaka

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check out from your hotel in Osaka. Then, board your transfer and get driven to the Kansai International Airpor for your flight back home, marking the end to your amazing couple getaway to Japan!
